sloka: अधिरूह्य ततो वीरः पर्वतं पवनात्मजः ।ददर्श सागरं भीमं मीनोरगनिषेवितम् ।। 5.56.24 ।।।।
transliteration: adhirūhya tato vīraḥ parvataṁ pavanātmajaḥ ।dadarśa sāgaraṁ bhīmaṁ mīnoraganiṣevitam ।। 5.56.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the heroic son of the Windgod, who had ascended the mountain saw the dreadful ocean inhabited by fishes and snakes.
